name: Berhampore
scopeLimits: The Murshidabad district administration directs citizens to West Bengal’s Banglarbhumi land-record service and lists its land-records service at the Berhampore SDO. Banglarbhumi advertises Plot Map Request and Mouza Map Request under Citizen Services, whose homepage says users must log in. No anonymous plot/mouza vector response, local Mouza assignment or exact parcel geometry was obtained. The Berhampore municipality site gives municipal context but no machine-readable boundary used here; the WUP point is not independently assigned to a ward or Mouza.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Official district Land Records service page explicitly places the SDO land-service office in the city of Berhampore and directs users to Banglarbhumi. This establishes local service/registry presence, while public map geometry and coverage at the WUP point remain unverified.
technicalBlocker: Banglarbhumi’s public homepage identifies map services as login-gated Citizen Services; its host timed out when the page was opened and no public geometry endpoint was verified.
remainingUncertainty: Exact point-to-Mouza/ward jurisdiction, online map availability for the relevant Mouza, and any anonymous vector endpoint remain unverified. State land-record access is broader than a city-specific cadastral API.
nextStep: Root review the state service evidence; if a city-specific geometry source is needed, first establish the WUP point’s Mouza/municipal jurisdiction and an official public map endpoint.

officialSources.observation: Murshidabad District administration says citizens access Land & Land Reforms Department services through Banglarbhumi and lists the Berhampore SDO office.
Bengali district page repeats the same official land-service portal and Berhampore location.
State Land & Land Reforms portal lists Plot Map Request, Mouza Map Request and Mouza Map Availability Details; page instructs users to log in before using Citizen Services.
Municipality page lists the civic body’s area/ward context; it did not provide a vector boundary or parcel data used in this review.
West Bengal Planning and Statistics describes state/district GIS administrative layers including Mouza boundaries; it is not a parcel layer.
